purpose: Brainstorm (not scheduled) for a part of the program for coaches and teachers: sharing data, a coach mode, focus plans, diagnosis, own content, assignments and class view.
details: Nothing described here exists in the program. Principles: privacy first (offline, no accounts, data travels only as files someone sends), builds on the stored answers with klad and thinking errors. Ideas numbered 1-8 with an order of steps C1... and questions for the sponsor (a coach) and open points such as consent.
summary: A brainstorm for coaches/teachers: principles (privacy first, offline, files), eight ideas (share package from parent to coach, coach mode with its own database, focus plan back to the child, side-by-side mode, diagnosis/intake test, own content, assignments and tests, class scale later), a proposed order, questions for the sponsor and open points (consent).
